verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a scraping service via Docker is a fair question for scraping products, so this axis applies. The evidence shows ScrapingBee only as a hosted API reached with an API key, plus a CLI and an MCP server. Nothing documents a Docker image or self-hosted deployment. Community remarks about running scrapers locally describe user workarounds with other tools and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the scraping service via a Docker container for production use
